item.title: Amazon Nova 2.5 Sonic
item.description: Nova 2.5 Sonic reached general availability on October 5, 2026. It runs real-time voice agents with better tool-calling and lower latency than the previous version.

item.title: Grok Voice 3.0
item.description: Grok Voice 3.0 is xAI’s speech-to-speech model for the Voice Agent API. The grok-voice-latest alias now points to it.
